unit: degrees Celsius above or below normal
encoding: uint8 value = round((A + 4) / 0.04); 255 = no data. Values beyond -4 or +4 show as -4 or +4.

colour_bar.source: NASA SVS 5176 sst_mur_anomaly_auto_colorbar_01.exr (linear light, shown with gamma 2.2)

daily.layout: daily/<YYYY-MM>.bin: 72 gzipped tiles (30 x 30 degrees, row by row from 90 N, 180 W), each uint8 31 days x 30 x 30, day d in slot d - 1, same encoding as weekly; ranges[month][tile] = [byte start, byte length]
